messages:
alex: Quick sync — sampleapp is replaying requests on 429s and causing duplicate side effects. Repro in local env with node sdk + python shim.
maria: Yup saw that on staging this morning. It triggers when refresh token and retry loops overlap.
sam: Can you paste the minimal log? cc @tiffany
alex: log snippet:
```
REQUEST id=abc123 Idempotency-Key=jk-1 -> 429
retrying... token_refresh start
REQUEST id=abc123 Idempotency-Key=undefined -> 200  <-- duplicated side-effect
```
tiffany: Seems SDK clears or re-generates idempotency header after auth refresh. We should avoid that. Server-side 429 handling also matters (Retry-After vs generic 429).
sam: Quick proposal: default safe_replay_window_ms = 5000; simple jitter: sleep = base*(2^n) + random(0, base_jitter_ms). Keep base_jitter_ms=100ms, cap=2000ms.
maria: Agree on defaults. Also add client-side replay_guard middleware to reject replay if last_sent_timestamp < now - window. For streaming endpoints we need a separate approach.
alex: Streaming is messy — can't always attach one idempotency key per chunk. For streaming recommend resumable session token + per-message dedupe ids.
tiffany: SDK parity item: node/python/go should all use same default window and jitter settings. Add e2e in sampleapp harness that simulates token refresh + 429.
dev-bot: ci: sampleapp-integration-tests failing on flaky retry test (build #482) :rotating_light:
sam: I'll add a deterministic test that injects a 429 during refresh and asserts single side-effect. Will PR tonight.
maria: UX note — update quickstart and troubleshooting: call out idempotency key usage and the safe replay window. Include snippet.
alex: code snippet for quickstart:
```
const id = uuidv4();
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = id; // reuse across retries + refresh
await client.post('/generate', {prompt}, {headers});
```
tiffany: :thumbsup: Roadmap: sam PR -> tests -> docs patch -> release patch. @lee can you tune rate-limiter to return Retry-After when we can? That will reduce unsafe replays.
lee: I can adjust the rate-limiter to include Retry-After for token-related 429s. Will coordinate with infra and push a config change tonight.
maria: Thanks — followups: (1) sam lands test PR (2) devex updates sampleapp harness (3) docs patch (4) include rollout note for Dedicated/Private.
alex: sounds good. If anyone hits more weird dupes, drop logs here. Thanks!
